body: when taylor announced midnights at the 2022 vmas she called it "the stories of 13 sleepless nights scattered throughout my life" -- then gave the standard album exactly 13 tracks. thirteen nights, thirteen songs. 13's been her lucky number since the beginning, and here she made it the whole blueprint.
